trustBoundaries.name: Next/browser → Express API
trustBoundaries.controls: exact-origin credentialed CORS, parser limits, response security headers
trustBoundaries.status: Mapped; controls require existing regressions plus scale-specific tests

trustBoundaries.name: Health → liveness response
trustBoundaries.controls: included in the API count; current health does not check PostgreSQL/scanner/readiness
trustBoundaries.status: Mapped; controls require existing regressions plus scale-specific tests

trustBoundaries.name: Unknown HTTP path → 404
trustBoundaries.controls: fall-through middleware, not an additional API route; response must not expose raw paths/secrets
trustBoundaries.status: Mapped; controls require existing regressions plus scale-specific tests

trustBoundaries.name: Unhandled API failure → sanitized response
trustBoundaries.controls: error middleware, not an additional API route; preserve status/error contract without raw dependency diagnostics
trustBoundaries.status: Mapped; controls require existing regressions plus scale-specific tests

trustBoundaries.name: Untrusted cookies → trusted live session
trustBoundaries.controls: signature/token/session/account/MFA checks; current session context bound server-side
trustBoundaries.status: Mapped; controls require existing regressions plus scale-specific tests

trustBoundaries.name: Trusted request → governance transaction
trustBoundaries.controls: serializable authority/session recheck and atomic audit; no client-inferred event membership
trustBoundaries.status: Mapped; controls require existing regressions plus scale-specific tests

trustBoundaries.name: Multipart bytes → scanner
trustBoundaries.controls: content/size checks and ClamAV fail-closed boundary before persistence
trustBoundaries.status: Mapped; controls require existing regressions plus scale-specific tests

trustBoundaries.name: Authorized bytes → local file storage
trustBoundaries.controls: local private storage; moving across instances requires an adapter and release authorization
trustBoundaries.status: Mapped; controls require existing regressions plus scale-specific tests

trustBoundaries.name: Authorized document ID → file response
trustBoundaries.controls: transactional authorization/audit before protected file stream
trustBoundaries.status: Mapped; controls require existing regressions plus scale-specific tests

trustBoundaries.name: Recovery capability → SMTP
trustBoundaries.controls: verified TLS; secrets excluded from logs; real provider delivery not verified
trustBoundaries.status: Mapped; controls require existing regressions plus scale-specific tests

trustBoundaries.name: Public finance snapshot → browser PDF
trustBoundaries.controls: local PDFKit generation; public snapshot disclosure rules remain required
trustBoundaries.status: Mapped; controls require existing regressions plus scale-specific tests

trustBoundaries.name: Operator Prisma tools → PostgreSQL
trustBoundaries.controls: baseline runtime credentials currently excessive (SEC-22); migration credentials need separation
trustBoundaries.status: Mapped; controls require existing regressions plus scale-specific tests
